description: This file contains CSS styles for managing themes and layout for the App component in a modern Tic Tac Toe game frontend.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container class for the application, setting styles for text alignment, background color, and transitions.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the logo image in the application, defining its size and pointer events.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for the header section of the application, establishing flexbox layout and color themes.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for links in the application, specifying text color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the theme toggle button, including styles for positioning, background color, and interactions.
